name: Mount Bromo
description: Active volcano in East Java, Indonesia, standing at 2,329 meters above sea level across four districts.
weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): 5°C–20°C with clear skies. Wet Season (November–April): 10°C–25°C with frequent rain.
trail_details: Jeep rides to viewpoints; ~2 km trek with 250+ steps to crater rim; volcanic sand surroundings.
required_gear: Thermal jacket, sturdy trekking boots, flashlight, sunscreen, dust mask.
difficulty_level: Easy to Moderate: Jeep rides minimize effort; optional crater trekking adds physical demand.
environmental_factors: Altitude: 2,329 m; Night: 5°C–10°C; Daytime: 15°C–20°C; Wind: 10–20 km/h.
physical_requirements: Minimal to moderate fitness; suitable for most visitors. Dust may irritate sensitive lungs.
main_attractions: Sunrise views, active crater, Teletubbies Hill with lush green savanna.
best_time_to_visit: May–October; early morning for sunrise and cooler temperatures.
tips_for_visitors: Dress warmly for early morning treks.

name: Mount Ijen
description: Volcano on Banyuwangi-Bondowoso border, East Java, 2,386 meters elevation. Known for rare blue fire phenomenon.
weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): 10°C–20°C, ideal for trekking. Wet Season: 12°C–22°C with higher humidity.
rainfall_intensity: Heaviest: December–February. Least: May–October; wet season creates muddy, slippery conditions.
trail_details: ~6 km round trip; 1.5–2 hours to crater rim; ~30 minutes rocky descent to blue fire site (optional).
required_gear: Thermal layers, waterproof jacket, sturdy trekking boots, gas mask for sulfur fumes, headlamp.
difficulty_level: Moderate: Steep 2 km incline; rocky crater descent optional. Requires trekking experience.
environmental_factors: Crater rim: 2,386 m; Night: 2°C–10°C; Daytime: 15°C–20°C; Wind: 10–20 km/h.
physical_requirements: Moderate fitness for 3–4 hour steep hikes. Unsuitable for asthma or severe respiratory issues.
main_attractions: Turquoise acidic crater lake (pH < 0.5), blue fire phenomenon, sunrise volcanic vistas.
best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season); midnight to early morning for blue fire and sunrise.
tips_for_visitors: Begin trek by 2 AM; pack gas mask, warm clothes, waterproof gear.

name: Bali
description: Indonesian province located in western Nusa Tenggara Islands; once part of Greater Sunda Province.

name: Surabaya
description: East Java provincial capital and second-largest metropolitan area in Indonesia after Jakarta.

name: Malang City
description: East Java city, second-largest in the province after Surabaya; 12th largest in Indonesia.

name: Madakaripura Waterfall
description: 200-meter waterfall in Probolinggo; highest on Java Island, second-highest in Indonesia within Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park.
weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): Best for visits with safer trails. Wet Season: Higher water flow, slippery conditions.
trail_details: ~1 km trail; ~30 minutes to waterfall; rocky paths, river crossings, water cascade navigation.
required_gear: Quick-dry clothes, waterproof items, water shoes/sandals, poncho, waterproof bag, snacks.
difficulty_level: Moderate: Wet terrain and river crossing navigation.
physical_requirements: Moderate fitness for uneven terrain and water crossings. Avoid heavy rains for flood safety.
main_attractions: 200 m tall waterfall, cave-like cliffsides creating mystical atmosphere.
best_time_to_visit: May–October; morning or early afternoon for lighting and fewer crowds.
tips_for_visitors: Bring waterproof gear and expect to get wet. Avoid visiting during heavy rain.

name: Tumpak Sewu Waterfall
description: 120-meter tiered waterfall between Lumajang-Malang regencies; curtain-like water flow pattern.
weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): Clear skies, 22°C–30°C. Wet Season: Frequent rains, slippery trails.
rainfall_intensity: Heaviest: December–February. Least: May–October for safer trekking.
trail_details: ~1 km round trip; 30–45 minutes descent; slippery paths, bamboo ladders, rocky terrain.
required_gear: Quick-dry clothes, waterproof layers, non-slip sandals/water shoes, poncho, waterproof bag, poles.
difficulty_level: Moderate: Steep paths and wet, rocky section navigation required.
environmental_factors: Altitude: 400 m; Temperature: 20°C–25°C; Humidity: 80%–90% with constant mist.
physical_requirements: Moderate fitness for uneven terrain and water crossings. Avoid during heavy rain.
main_attractions: Horseshoe-shaped waterfall with mesmerizing cascading water views.
best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season); morning for cooler temps and better lighting.
tips_for_visitors: Wear waterproof gear and expect to get wet. Avoid trekking during or after heavy rain.

name: Papuma Beach
description: Popular beach in Jember Regency; name abbreviates 'Malikan White Sand'; located in Lojejer Village.
weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): Clear skies, 24°C–32°C. Wet Season: Occasional rain, warmer temps.
trail_details: Beach walks and short hikes to Siti Hinggil Hill; 20–30 min viewpoint exploration or 1–2 hours full tour.
required_gear: Lightweight breathable clothes, sandals/water shoes, sunscreen, hat, water.
difficulty_level: Easy: Well-maintained paths, suitable for all ages, no steep inclines.
environmental_factors: Temperature: 24°C–32°C; Wind: 5–15 km/h; Humidity: Moderate to high.
physical_requirements: Minimal fitness required; ideal for families and older adults.
main_attractions: Karst limestone cliff formations, Siti Hinggil Hill panoramic views, crystal clear waters.
best_time_to_visit: May–October; morning or late afternoon for cooler weather and sunset views.
tips_for_visitors: Bring cash for local food stalls. Avoid swimming during high tide.

name: Taman Safari Prigen
description: World-class zoo and conservation site recognized as best by Indonesian Ministry of Forestry.
weather_by_season: Dry Season (May–October): Clear skies, 18°C–28°C ideal for exploration. Wet Season: Warmer with frequent rain.
rainfall_intensity: Heaviest: December–February. Least: May–October for pleasant animal viewing conditions.
trail_details: Paved accessible paths; explore via car for safari portion; foot access to Baby Zoo and amusement park.
required_gear: Lightweight comfortable clothing, walking shoes, hat, sunscreen, water bottle, camera.
difficulty_level: Easy: Accessible for all ages including families with young children and older adults.
environmental_factors: Altitude: 800 m; Mild, cooler than lowlands; Temperature milder morning/evening; Humidity: 70%–80%.
physical_requirements: Minimal fitness required; limited walking to specific areas; well-maintained accessible paths.
main_attractions: Semi-natural animal habitats (elephants, tigers, lions, giraffes, zebras), water park, amusement rides, dining.
best_time_to_visit: May–October for better weather; morning or late afternoon when animals are active.
tips_for_visitors: Bring water, sunscreen, camera. Purchase tickets in advance. Follow rules: stay in vehicles during safari.
